essentials.title: Muhimman abubuwa
essentials.text: Abin da ake karantawa da farko a katin baje koli: suna, jumla mai jan hankali, fasahohi.

images.title: Hotuna
images.text: Hoton bango, sannan hotunan allo na abin da ke aiki tuni. Shi ne ke sa a danna.

story.title: Labari
story.text: Matsalar da aikin ke warwarewa, ga wa, inda ya kai, da abin da zai biyo baya.

links.title: Hanyoyi da lasisi
links.text: Inda za a karanta lambar, inda za a gwada ta, da abin da kowa ke da izinin yi da ita.

team.title: Ƙungiya
team.text: Kana neman masu ba da gudummawa? Kowane matsayi ya zama sanarwa, da bayanan martaba masu dacewa ke gani.

fields.name: Sunan aikin
fields.nameHint: Sunan ma'ajiyar, ko wanda masu amfani da shi suka sani. Adireshin shafin ya samo asali daga gare shi kuma ba zai canza ba.
fields.taglinePlaceholder: Motocin bas na Lagos masu zuwa, ko babu intanet
fields.taglineHint: Jumla ɗaya don katin baje koli: me aikin ke yi, kuma ga wa.
fields.tagsHint: Harsuna, tsare-tsare, batutuwa (har {{count}}): haka mutanen da suka dace ke samun aikin.
fields.descriptionPlaceholder:
Matsalar, mafita, inda aikin ya kai…

- Abin da ke aiki tuni
- Abin da zai biyo baya
fields.descriptionHint: Sakin layi, **rubutu mai kauri**, `lamba` da jeri: haka shafin aikin ke nuna su. {{mod}} + Enter don wallafawa.

about.MIT: MIT: gajere kuma mai sassauci. Kowa zai iya sake amfani da lambar, ko a cikin samfurin da aka rufe, idan ya ambaci marubucin.
about.Apache-2.0: Apache 2.0: mai sassauci, tare da kariya daga haƙƙin mallaka. Zaɓin da kamfanoni suka saba.
about.BSD-3-Clause: BSD 3: mai sassauci kamar MIT, kuma ta hana amfani da sunanka don tallata aikin da aka samo.
about.MPL-2.0: MPL 2.0: fayilolin da aka gyara suna kasancewa a buɗe; sauran samfurin zai iya kasancewa a rufe.
about.GPL-3.0: GPL 3.0: duk wata manhaja da aka samo kuma aka rarraba dole ta kasance a buɗe, ƙarƙashin lasisi ɗaya.
about.AGPL-3.0: AGPL 3.0: kamar GPL, kuma sabis ɗin intanet da ke amfani da ita dole ya wallafa lambarsa ma.

license.aboutNone: Ba tare da lasisi ba, babu wanda ke da haƙƙin doka na sake amfani da lambar: zaɓi ɗaya kafin karɓar masu ba da gudummawa.

team.recruitingOff: Kunna shi don karɓar masu ba da gudummawa da wallafa matsayai. Za ka iya yin hakan daga baya.
